newsitem.title: USA: Polaroid hires Kraft executive - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Polaroid hires Kraft executive - WSJ.

text.p: Polaroid Corp has hired a senior official from Kraft Inc as executive vice president in charge of its consumer-products operations, the Wall Street Journal reported on Tuesday.
The newspaper quoted Gary DiCamillo, the company's chairman and chief executive officer, as saying Polaroid would announce the appointment of Serafino Posa on Tuesday.

Posa, who was senior vice president for business development at the Kraft foods division of Philip Morris Cos, will be responsible for about 45 percent of Polaroid's $2.2 billion in annual revenues, it said.
